pdf_script = """\
from docx import Document
from fpdf import FPDF
import os

doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

pdf = FPDF()
pdf.set_margins(15, 15, 15)
pdf.add_page()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)

for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text.strip()
    if not text:
        pdf.ln(4)
        continue
    safe = text.encode("latin-1", errors="replace").decode("latin-1")
    style = para.style.name.lower() if para.style else ""
    if "heading" in style or "title" in style:
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 14)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, safe)
        pdf.ln(3)
    else:
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 11)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 7, safe)
        pdf.ln(2)

for table in doc.tables:
    pdf.ln(5)
    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 10)
    for i, row in enumerate(table.rows):
        cells = [cell.text.strip() for cell in row.cells]
        safe_cells = [c.encode("latin-1", errors="replace").decode("latin-1") for c in cells]
        line = " | ".join(safe_cells)
        if i == 0:
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 10)
        else:
            pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 10)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 6, line)
        pdf.ln(1)

out_path = "/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf"
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True)
pdf.output(out_path)
print(f"PDF created at {out_path}")
print(f"File size: {os.path.getsize(out_path)} bytes")
"""
